Finish paginated invoice listing; the scheduler fix is paused.

## Recent work
Stress tests and full suite passed. Added `InvoicePage`; service supports `limit=20`, `offset=0`; route now validates and passes query parameters. Last test before route update had 8 passed, 1 failed because the response remained a bare list.
